---
title: "Creating a Profile Page on the OSC Website"
---

A profile page should be created for every new member.

For detailed instructions, see [Creating a New Member Profile Page](../updating-website/create-new-members-page.qmd) in the Updating website chapter.

In principle, we can ask more than what is currently asked in the onboarding emails sent upon [Requests to Become an OSC Member](../osc-outreach/responding-requests.qmd), such as selected publication, research interest, and more.
